title: Pollen gets automatic top-ups
summary:
Auto top-ups came to Pollen settings, while the community catalog gained two apps and clearer contributor credits.

Enter added auto top-up settings and Stripe Customer Portal access. Users can choose a Pollen pack for automatic purchase when their paid balance reaches 5 Pollen or less, and manage payment methods, billing details, and invoices.

The agent-maintained catalog added @ganya002’s Pollenforge-CLI, which formats Markdown, and Storytale, a multiplayer game for writing a shared story one sentence at a time. The Greenhouse now lists 738 apps.

A README update replaced generic platform credits with contributor credits for The room, The Stream Church Webapp, and AI Art Gallery.
